John Lithgow stars as Roald Dahl in an electrifying mix of fact and fiction … This work doesn’t bring a new perspective to the political territory or to the real Roald Dahl, who died in 1990. cn.t: Mark Rosenblatt's Olivier-winning drama earns near-universal acclaim for its bold, urgent exploration of Roald Dahl's antisemitism, with critics hailing John Lithgow's performance as enthralling and the production as essential theatre.
